notes: Version 1.3. Retitled (formerly '... Structure of the Residual Amplitude Factor and Pipeline-Independent Formulation'). Tests P2 and P3 are open problems and are not carried out, so the paper no longer claims to identify which case holds or to construct a pipeline-independent canonical observable; the former Proposition 7.2 (pipeline independence), whose proof sketch depended on those tests, is withdrawn and kept as Open Problem 7.2. The exclusion of the fourth case by an O17 q = 29 counter-example is withdrawn: within its toy model that check verifies the raw-count block-independence identity and computes no normalised factor. In the fourth case, which holds on O16's contract with r = 1, no canonicalisation is needed. The reported values r(c,q) in {1,2,3,4} are a historical hypothesis; O16 shows r = 1 on the real O12/O13 pipeline within its contract, and O17's normalisation statement is internal to its toy model. Lemma 2.1, Definition 2.2, Lemma 2.4, Corollary 2.5 and Proposition 9.1 are unchanged.
